evals.name: search-verification-tag
evals.prompt: Bing Webmaster Tools gave me a verification code, 0A1B2C3D4E5F. Add it to the site so I can verify ownership.
evals.expected_output: The verification is added as a meta tag in src/components/SeoHead.astro, which every layout includes, rather than as a file in public/. The build and check:seo pass.
assertions: Adds a msvalidate.01 meta tag with the code to src/components/SeoHead.astro
Adds no verification .html or .xml file under public/
Does not add the tag to only one of BaseLayout.astro or WritingLayout.astro
bun run build and bun run check:seo pass, and the final message says they ran
The final message shows the tag in the rendered head of a page and of a post

evals.name: noindex-now-page
evals.prompt: Add a /now/ page that says what I'm working on this month: finishing the budget series and reading about evaluation. Keep it out of search results.
evals.expected_output: A /now/ page built on the existing layouts and tokens that renders noindex, with the sitemap filter in astro.config.mjs updated so check:seo still finds the sitemap equal to the indexable pages.
assertions: Adds src/pages/now.astro (or now/index.astro) using an existing layout
The sitemap filter in astro.config.mjs excludes /now/
bun run build, bun run check:seo, and bun run check:vitals pass
Introduces no new colors or fonts outside src/styles/theme.css and fonts.css
The final message shows the rendered page at phone and desktop widths
